title: Operations Analyst
description:
Accounting Specialist

The Accounting Specialist will support teams across multiple jurisdictions, primarily Bermuda and the British Virgin Islands, in delivering accounting and financial reporting services.

Working closely with our client relationship managers and other internal teams, the role will focus on reviewing transaction records, assisting with the preparation of management accounts, financial statements, and regulatory reporting, while ensuring the integrity of accounting records and supporting the delivery of high-quality service delivery.

This role provides an opportunity to work within a global professional services firm that services international clients across a range of industries.



What Will You Do

• Review transaction records and financial data

• Prepare and maintain accounting records and ledgers

• Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual management accounts 

• Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards

• Assist with the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial models

• Prepare and review cash flow statements and financial analysis

• Assist with the preparation of annual returns and regulatory filings 

• Ensure financial records meet statutory and regulatory reporting requirements

• Support the preparation of information required for regulatory submissions and compliance reviews

• Act as a key point of contact in supporting audit processes

• Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for external auditors

• Respond to internal accounting queries

• Monthly computation of Bermuda payrolls for start-up companies (both manually and within the Great Plains system) and quarterly submission of tax filings.

• Build effective working relationships with internal service teams

• Monitor the integrity of financial ledgers and review bookkeeping entries

• Support the development and maintenance of accounting procedures and internal controls

• Assist with process improvement initiatives 

• Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with firm policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements



What You’ll Need

• Internationally recognized accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CA or equivalent), or working toward qualification

• 3–6 years of accounting experience, preferably within a professional services firm, accounting practice, or financial services environment

• Experience preparing financial statements and management accounts

• Strong Excel and financial analysis skills

• Experience working with accounting systems (e.g., Viewpoint or similar platforms) is an advantage

• Experience working with international services environment is beneficial

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• High level of attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities

• Collaborative team mindset and strong internal service orientation

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a global team



Note: This is an onsite work that will be transitioning to Hybrid setup before the end of 2026.

title: Web designer/builder
description:
Part-Time WordPress Developer (Avada Expert) - Long-Term Role, UK Design Agency



I run a UK web design agency specialising in medical websites - doctors, surgeons, clinics. Sixteen years established, growing, and I need an excellent WordPress developer/builder to build my designs.



The work: I design the homepage, you build it pixel-perfect in the Avada builder, then use it as the design system to create the inner pages yourself: same fonts, colours, spacing, style and quality, applied with your own creativity. You need a genuine eye for design, not just build skills. Consistent ongoing work, this is a long-term role for the right person, starting 10–20 hours/week with more available as we grow.



Important - read this twice: everything is built natively in Avada. No custom coding, no workarounds, no hand-coded sections. Every site must be fully editable in the Avada builder by anyone on my team. If your instinct is to jump into CSS and PHP to solve problems, this isn't the role for you. If you know Avada deeply enough to achieve pixel-perfect results within the builder, you're exactly who I'm looking for.



You must have:



Expert-level Avada experience - you've built full sites in it, not just edited them

Design sensibility - you can take a homepage and extend its style across a whole site so it looks like one designer made it

A sharp eye for detail - "close enough" is not close enough

Excellent written English

Reliable availability with some overlap with UK hours



Pay: $10–15/hour depending on experience - top of the market, paid reliably every month, because I only want the best and I pay accordingly.



How it starts: a paid test task - I give you a finished homepage, you build one inner page that matches its style. Do it brilliantly and the role is yours.



To apply: start your application with the word CORAL, and include links to 2 Avada sites you built yourself, telling me which parts were your work. Applications that skip this won't be read.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - U.S. Local Businesses

This role is focused on speaking with business owners, identifying interest in a professionally managed website and related smart business products, booking qualified appointments, and recording accurate call outcomes. You will not be responsible for closing sales, collecting payments, finding leads, or performing technical website work.



We provide:

- A Millennium calling number or approved calling system

- Product and offer training

- An approved call process and objection guidance

- A scheduling link and simple lead tracker

- Coaching during the paid trial



Responsibilities:

- Call supplied U.S. local-business leads during approved U.S. Eastern business hours

- Speak naturally and professionally with owners or decision-makers

- Ask basic qualification questions and book interested prospects

- Record every call outcome and useful notes accurately

- Respect all do-not-call and opt-out requests immediately

- Protect lead information and follow Millennium's data-handling rules



Requirements:

- Clear, confident, and easy-to-understand spoken English

- Previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience, preferably with U.S. businesses

- Reliable internet, a quality wired headset, a quiet workspace, and backup connectivity

- Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

- Experience recording call outcomes in a CRM or spreadsheet

- Reliable, coachable, organized, and comfortable handling rejection respectfully

- Willing to use only Millennium's approved calling system and caller identity



Important rules:

- Do not scrape, purchase, or add your own leads

- Do not use personal, spoofed, or rotating phone numbers

- Do not download, copy, or reuse Millennium lead lists

- Do not collect payment or request payment information

- Do not claim to represent or be affiliated with Google

- Do not promise discounts, rankings, guaranteed results, or delivery dates



Hiring process:

1. Submit your location, timezone, relevant experience, industries previously called, available U.S. hours, and equipment details.

5. The selected candidate will begin with a paid 10-hour supervised trial at $5 USD per hour.



Strong performance may lead to ongoing part-time work. A future performance bonus may be introduced for verified qualified appointments that attend, but no bonus amount is promised at this stage.

Hot Tanks is looking for a reliable freelance Video Editor to turn approved raw footage into clear, professional, brand-consistent video content.



You will work with footage created by the Hot Tanks TEAM and prepare finished video assets for platforms such as Instagram,
, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and the Hot Tanks website.



This is primarily an editing role. Hot Tanks manages the content strategy, planning, approvals, scheduling, and publishing.



## What You Will Edit



Content may include:



* Educational and expert videos

* Client testimonials and review videos

* Short testimonial clips

* Installation and project footage

* Before-and-after videos

* Field B-roll

* Technician and TEAM introductions

* Service-quality and Signature Standard videos

* Client journey and “what to expect” videos

* Community content

* Behind-the-scenes and TEAM culture content



## Core Responsibilities



You will:



* Review raw footage provided by Hot Tanks.

* Select the strongest usable moments.

* Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated takes, and unusable footage.

* Create clean, natural edits with strong pacing.

* Keep speakers sounding natural and human.

* Add approved:



  * Logos

  * Lower thirds

  * Captions

  * Text overlays

  * Service labels

  * Transition cards

  * End frames

  * Calls to action

* Make basic adjustments to:



  * Audio

  * Exposure

  * Colour

  * Framing

* Add B-roll when it improves the story or explanation.

* Create vertical and horizontal versions when required.

* Create thumbnails when required.

* Export videos in the correct dimensions, resolution, and file format.

* Keep project files and finished exports organized.

* Complete reasonable revisions based on consolidated Hot Tanks feedback.



## Common Video Formats



Typical work may include:



### 9:16 Vertical Video



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts



### 16:9 Horizontal Video



* YouTube Main Videos

* Website videos

*
 native video



### Other Common Deliverables



* 15–30 second clips

* 30–60 second short-form videos

* 1–3 minute videos

* Thumbnails

* Occasional longer-form videos when required



Some source footage may require more than one finished format.



For example, the same source footage may be edited into both a vertical and horizontal version.



## Editing Style



Hot Tanks content should feel:



* Professional

* Clear

* Warm

* Trustworthy

* Clean

* Calm

* Natural

* Consistent



The goal is not to make every video flashy or heavily produced.



The finished video should help the viewer feel:



* “I understand what they are explaining.”

* “These people know what they are doing.”

* “They seem professional.”

* “I would feel comfortable having them in my home.”



## We Prefer



* Clean cuts

* Natural pacing

* Easy-to-read captions

* Simple graphics

* Consistent branding

* Strong opening moments

* Useful B-roll

* Minimal unnecessary effects

* Clear endings and calls to action



## Please Avoid



* Excessive animation

* Distracting transitions

* Aggressive zooming

* Overused sound effects

* Excessive text

* Meme-style editing unless specifically requested

* Trend-heavy editing that weakens the Hot Tanks brand

* Editing that changes the meaning of what someone said



## Brand Protection



The Video Editor must follow approved Hot Tanks brand assets, templates, and editing standards.



Do not independently:



* Change logos.

* Change brand colours.

* Rewrite approved company promises or standards.

* Create new company claims.

* Change the meaning of a client testimonial.

* Add pricing, guarantees, technical claims, or promotional language that was not provided or approved.

* Publish content directly unless specifically authorized.



Hot Tanks controls final approval and publishing.



## Monthly Work Structure



Work will normally be provided in organized batches rather than as isolated one-off videos.



The monthly workload may include a mix of:



* Short-form videos

* Simple edits

* Alternate versions of the same source footage

* Testimonial edits

* Educational videos

* Mid-length videos

* Occasional longer-form pieces

* Thumbnails



The mix and volume of work may vary slightly from month to month within the agreed scope.



The agreed monthly flat rate covers the regular editing workload established between Hot Tanks and the selected editor.



One consolidated revision round per assignment is normally expected.



## What Hot Tanks Provides



Hot Tanks will provide:



* Raw footage

* Content direction

* Required dimensions

* Brand assets

* Reference examples when needed

* Required text, labels, or end frames

* Editing instructions

* Consolidated feedback



The editor is not expected to independently create the overall content strategy.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person should have:



* Strong short-form video editing skills.

* Good pacing and storytelling judgement.

* Experience editing vertical and horizontal video.

* Experience preparing social-media-ready content.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Reliable file organization.

* Strong written English for captions and on-screen text.

* Ability to follow templates, instructions, and standards consistently.

* Ability to receive feedback and apply it without repeatedly making the same corrections.

* Reliable communication.

* Reliable turnaround.

* Good judgement about when to cut and when to let a moment breathe.



Experience with home services, trades, testimonials, educational content, or local-business marketing is helpful but not required.



## Software



You may use professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Similar professional editing software



We care more about the quality and consistency of the finished work than the specific software used.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful Video Editor:



* Learns the Hot Tanks editing style.

* Delivers clean, publication-ready videos.

* Requires fewer corrections over time.

* Keeps branding consistent.

* Meets agreed deadlines.

* Keeps files organized.

* Communicates clearly.

* Handles repeatable monthly production reliably.

* Turns raw footage into useful finished assets the Hot Tanks TEAM can publish confidently.



## Compensation



**Monthly Compensation Range: $500–$1,000 CAD**



This is an ongoing freelance/contract editing role.



The final monthly rate will be agreed upon based on:



* Experience

* Editing quality

* Efficiency

* Ability to follow the Hot Tanks editing standard

* Communication and reliability

* Agreed monthly workload



We are looking for a flat monthly arrangement that reflects the agreed workload rather than pricing every individual video separately.



## Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test editing project using actual Hot Tanks footage.



The purpose of the test is to allow both Hot Tanks and the editor to determine whether the working relationship is a good fit before entering into an ongoing monthly arrangement.



The paid test will evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Pacing and storytelling

* Ability to follow instructions

* Brand consistency

* Caption and on-screen text accuracy

* Attention to detail

* Communication

* Turnaround time and reliability

* Ability to apply feedback



The test project will be compensated at an agreed project rate before the work begins.



Completion of the paid test does not guarantee an ongoing contract. Candidates whose work is a strong fit may be offered the monthly freelance editing role.



This role is focused on turning approved Hot Tanks footage into strong, consistent, publication-ready video content.

description:

About us



Snapline (
) is a small US software company. We give contractors (roofers first) a business phone line that texts back missed calls in five seconds, a Google review flow, and a website. The founder runs every demo and closes every sale. Your job is to fill his calendar.

• Short daily summary at the end of each shift: dials, conversations, bookings.



Hours



Two blocks, Monday to Friday, Pacific time: 7 to 9 in the morning and 4 to 6 in the afternoon. That is 10 pm to midnight and 7 to 9 am Manila time. Contractors answer before and after they are on the roof, so these hours are fixed. Do not apply if you cannot keep them every weekday.



You



• At least one year of outbound calling to US businesses, on the phone, not chat or
. Contractors, real estate, or home services is a plus.

• Clear, natural English. You will talk to busy tradesmen who decide in ten seconds whether to hang up.

• Comfortable with rejection. Most calls end in no. The good ones end in a booking.

• Quiet room, wired internet, a USB headset, and backup internet or power. We provide the softphone and the US number.

• Honest logging. We listen to recordings. A booking that did not happen is the end of the trial.



What we provide



The script, the objection sheet, the list, the softphone, and the founder listening to your first calls with you. A four week paid trial, then ongoing.



How to apply



Put the word ROOF as the first word of your application, then:



1. A voice recording, 60 seconds or less, reading this opener as if you were on a live call: “Hi, is this Mike? This is  with Snapline. You are on a roof and your phone rings. What happens to that call? Right. We make your phone text them back in five seconds so they do not call the next roofer, and you keep your number.”



2. Two sentences on the last US cold calling job you had and what you were booking.

 

3. Confirm you can work 10 pm to midnight and 7 to 9 am Manila time, Monday to Friday.



Applications without the word, the recording, or the confirmation are not read.

title: Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel
description:
Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel 



**Job Type:** Freelance / Ongoing, Long-Term

**Workload:** 2 videos per week (recurring)

**Turnaround:** Fast — see details below



## About the Channel

"Permanent Jewelry, Real Talk" is a growing YouTube channel for permanent jewelry business owners — covering industry trends, business strategy, tools, and honest, no-fluff advice from a founder who's built a real studio with a team. The tone is warm, honest, and direct — like a friend leveling with you, not a polished corporate brand. We're looking for a long-term editing partner to help bring that personality to life visually.



## What You'll Be Doing

You'll receive raw, unedited sit-down talking-head footage (filmed in batches) along with any supporting photos/clips, and turn it into a polished, engaging final video — twice a week, on a consistent schedule.



## Must-Haves

- **A sharp, intriguing editing style** — you know how to take a straightforward talking-head video and make it visually engaging: pacing, cuts, zooms, text call-outs, and creative transitions that keep viewers watching, not just a static edit.

- **Fast, reliable turnaround** — you can take raw footage and deliver a finished, upload-ready video within an agreed turnaround window (please state your typical turnaround time in your application).

- **Strong command of professional editing software** (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar — no template-only tools).

- **Thumbnail design skills** — you'll also be creating custom, high-CTR thumbnails for each video (bold, clear, mobile-readable at a glance).

- **Real YouTube knowledge** — you understand what keeps modern viewers watching: strong hooks in the first few seconds, pacing that holds retention, on-screen text/captions, and current best practices for what performs on the platform (not just generic editing).

- **Consistency and communication** — reliable delivery on schedule, responsive communication, and the ability to take feedback and revise quickly.



## Nice-to-Haves

- Experience editing for business/education or personal-brand YouTube channels (not just entertainment or vlogs).

- Experience adding lower-thirds, on-screen graphics, or a consistent recurring intro/outro treatment to build a cohesive channel look.

- Comfortable syncing captions/subtitles.

- Basic motion graphics or animated text/callout skills.

- Experience repurposing long-form content into short-form clips (a plus, not required initially).



## What We'll Provide

- Raw footage, filmed and delivered in batches on a consistent schedule.

- Brand direction: tone, colors, and style guidance so every video feels consistent.

- Clear, prompt feedback on drafts.



## To Apply, Please Include:

1. Your portfolio or samples of similar talking-head/educational YouTube edits (this matters most — please don't apply without samples).

2. Your typical turnaround time per video.

3. The software you edit in.

4. Your availability for a recurring, long-term 2x/week workload.

5. Your rate per video (edit + thumbnail).



Looking for a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig — if this sounds like your kind of project, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Entry-Level AI Graphic Designer
description:
AI Graphic Designer

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $3 to $6 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.

You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.

That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Designer.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $3 to $6 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.

Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

What You'll Learn Here

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.

Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software

A portfolio of creatives with performance numbers attached, which is the thing that gets designers hired at the next level

Not a Fit If

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

You want to make art rather than ads that perform

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content VA – Instagram Reels + DM Follow-Ups
description:
Short-Form Video Editor & Content VA – Instagram Reels + DM Follow-Ups



I run an online fitness coaching business specialising in helping tradesmen and FIFO workers improve their body composition, strength, fitness and lifestyle.



We're growing our social media presence and I'm looking for a creative, reliable and proactive **Short-Form Video Editor & Content Virtual Assistant** to work with me long-term.



This is NOT just a basic admin VA role.



The main focus of this position will be helping me turn ideas and raw footage into high-quality Instagram Reels consistently, while also helping with content ideation, scripting and light Instagram lead follow-up.



### Your Main Responsibilities



1. Short-Form Video Editing – Main Priority**



You will edit approximately **14+ Instagram Reels per week**, as well as occasional paid ads.



I will provide the raw footage and examples/frameworks for the style we're looking for.



Depending on the video, editing may include:



* Cutting and trimming footage

* Removing pauses and improving pacing

* Adding engaging captions/text on screen

* Adding B-roll and overlay images/videos

* Sound effects

* Music

* Zooms and other pattern interrupts

* Basic transitions and effects

* Creating strong visual hooks

* Following reference videos and recreating editing styles

* Making sure videos are formatted correctly for Instagram Reels

* Exporting finished videos ready for me to review and post



Some videos will be extremely simple. Others will require more detailed editing.



The goal is that I can send you the raw footage and receive back a **finished piece of content that is ready to post.**



2. Content Ideation & Scripting



I will provide you with our content frameworks, target audience information, previous successful content and examples.



You will help:



* Research content ideas

* Develop Reel concepts

* Research hooks and angles

* Turn ideas into scripts I can film

* Repurpose successful ideas into new angles

* Organise ideas into a monthly content plan

* Help us produce enough ideas/scripts for approximately 14 Reels per week

* Look at successful content in our niche and identify concepts we can adapt to our brand



You do NOT need to invent our entire marketing strategy from scratch.



I will provide the frameworks. I need somebody who can learn them, understand them and eventually take more ownership over executing them.



3. Instagram DM Follow-Up



We are growing our Instagram audience and generate hundreds of new followers each month.



I currently handle the initial outreach and important sales conversations myself.



Your role will primarily involve:



* Keeping track of conversations

* Following up people who haven't responded

* Following our DM follow-up scripts

* Identifying people showing buying intent

* Letting me know when someone responds and should be taken over personally

* Helping ensure leads don't simply get forgotten in the inbox



Over time, there may be an opportunity to take on more responsibility with DM conversations and booking calls.



### Who I'm Looking For



You should:



* Have strong experience editing short-form content

* Be confident using **CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software**

* Understand Instagram Reels, TikTok and short-form content

* Understand hooks, attention, pacing and retention

* Have strong written English

The Tax Accountant is responsible for preparing accurate and timely federal and state tax filings for individuals and business clients. This role requires strong attention to detail, a deep understanding of tax laws, and the ability to work collaboratively within a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate technical proficiency, clear communication skills, and a proactive approach to client service.

-Experience preparing multi-state returns and managing complex client portfolios.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to present financial information clearly to non-technical audiences.

-Flexibility to work extended hours during peak tax seasons to meet client and filing deadlines.

title: Multiple Paid Remote Roles for Feminist Company
description:
Please read this entire posting carefully before applying.



ABOUT THIS RECRUITMENT



Décalage Solutions is building a small, skilled, values-aligned remote core team. We are recruiting for multiple paid positions across several areas of the business.



This is not one position requiring one person to perform every function listed below. We are looking for professionals with genuine expertise in different areas. We would rather hire several people with demonstrated depth in their respective fields than one person who claims to do everything.



Opportunities may be part-time, project-based, or ongoing, depending on the function, current business needs, and each applicant’s demonstrated ability.



Compensation ranges from $8 to $15 USD per hour, depending on the role, experience, and demonstrated level of skill.



These opportunities are open only to women and transgender applicants.



Across every position, we want professionals who communicate directly, think critically, recognize problems, recommend solutions, take responsibility for their work, and care about the success of the company.



ABOUT DÉCALAGE SOLUTIONS



Décalage Solutions is a feminist company serving women who are creating social, political, and community change.



Our growing business includes private advisory and coaching, online education, community programming, retreats, speaking, writing, content creation, conscious travel, partnerships, and other values-led projects.



We are building a financially successful business without separating commercial success from political and ethical responsibility.



WHAT WE STAND FOR



Our work is grounded in intersectional feminism.



This means we understand that gender inequality cannot be separated from racism, colonialism, class, disability, sexuality, gender identity, migration, economic inequality, and other systems of power.



Our values include:



* Feminism that challenges patriarchy rather than helping individual women succeed at the expense of others

* Anti-racism and an active commitment to confronting white supremacy

* Anti-colonial practice and respect for Indigenous sovereignty, knowledge, and self-determination

* Palestinian liberation and meaningful commitment to the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement

* LGBTQ+ inclusion and respect for people of all sexual orientations and gender identities

* Disability justice and accessibility

* Economic and labour justice

* Human rights, collective liberation, and community responsibility

* Ethical consumption and corporate accountability

* Trauma-informed, anti-oppressive, and non-exploitative ways of working

* Respect for women’s autonomy, expertise, bodies, choices, and leadership

* Recognition that no person’s liberation should depend upon the oppression, exploitation, or disposability of another community



We do not practise a feminism that centres only privileged women, treats individual corporate success as liberation, ignores racism and colonialism, excludes transgender people, or remains silent about genocide and state violence.



This is not a politically neutral workplace.



Identity alone does not establish values alignment. Being a woman or transgender does not automatically mean that someone understands or supports feminism, intersectionality, anti-racism, anti-colonial practice, Palestinian liberation, LGBTQ+ rights, or BDS.



Applicants must understand these commitments, take them seriously, and demonstrate how they would affect their actual work.



AREAS IN WHICH WE ARE RECRUITING



We are recruiting professionals with demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:



* Operations and project management

* Executive assistance

* Administrative and virtual assistance

* Launch strategy and coordination

* Funnel implementation and testing

*
 marketing and automation

* Copywriting and sales-page support

* Social-media strategy, management, and scheduling

* Video editing and content production

* Systems, standard operating procedures, and workflow development

* Client experience and customer support

* Retreat and event coordination

* Partnership, sponsorship, and affiliate development

* Travel, venue, and hospitality coordination

* Website, technology, and platform support

* Contractor and team coordination

* Progress reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking

*Bookkeeping, accounting, and cross-border financial compliance, including Canadian, U.S., and Paraguayan requirements, with the ability and willingness to research additional jurisdictions as needed



We are not looking for one person to perform every function.



Do not claim that you can perform everything listed. Identify the areas in which you have genuine professional competence and provide evidence of what you have accomplished.



Applicants must explain:



* What they can perform independently at a professional level

* What they can perform with direction

* What they are currently learning

* What they are not qualified to perform

* What measurable results they have previously produced



Honest self-assessment is part of professional competence.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for people who:



* Read complete instructions carefully

* Pay attention to context, details, and deadlines

* Are genuinely skilled, not simply willing to try

* Can provide evidence of previous work and results

* Communicate clearly, directly, and confidently in English

* Ask thoughtful questions when information is missing or unclear

* Are comfortable communicating through written messages, meetings, video, and voice notes

* Can give, receive, and implement constructive feedback

* Think critically rather than automatically agreeing

* Can respectfully challenge an idea and explain their reasoning

* Notice problems and propose practical solutions

* Exercise independent professional judgment

* Take ownership of their work, decisions, and mistakes

* Meet deadlines and arrive prepared and on time

* Communicate early when a genuine emergency affects a commitment

* Can distinguish between an unavoidable emergency and a competing personal priority

* Work independently without disappearing, silently guessing, or requiring constant supervision

* Care about quality, client experience, revenue, and measurable business results

* Are emotionally intelligent, mature, dependable, discreet, and professional

* Can communicate professionally with senior leaders, clients, partners, sponsors, affiliates, venues, speakers, and other organizations

* Want to contribute to a strong team rather than complete disconnected tasks mechanically



We do not want “yes people.”



If you see a problem, risk, inconsistency, or better way to accomplish something, we expect you to raise it respectfully. We value informed professional opinions, sound reasoning, and people who can explain why they recommend a particular approach.



Discussion must lead to action. Strong communication is not a substitute for completing excellent work.



FEMINIST VALUES, ETHICAL JUDGMENT, AND BDS



Every team member must remain aware of the company’s ethical commitments and apply them consistently.



Décalage Solutions supports Palestinian liberation and takes the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement seriously.



Team members must not select or recommend companies, platforms, products, speakers, venues, sponsors, affiliates, partners, media outlets, suppliers, or service providers without considering who owns them, what they support, and whether working with them is consistent with our values.



This responsibility applies to every role.



Team members may be expected to:



* Research company ownership, parent companies, investors, partnerships, and corporate conduct

* Check companies and products for known BDS targets and other ethical concerns

* Consider anti-racist, anti-colonial, feminist, LGBTQ+ inclusive, disability, labour, environmental, and human-rights implications

* Identify potential conflicts before presenting a recommendation

* Explain the evidence and reasoning behind an assessment

* Recommend ethical alternatives when an option is not aligned

* Continue monitoring relevant information rather than assuming that a company’s status will never change



If you do not know whether something is aligned, you are expected to investigate and ask.



You must never assume that an option is acceptable simply because it is popular, convenient, profitable, or used by other companies.



Applicants will be tested on their understanding of our values and on how they would apply those values within their specific area of work.



Repeating definitions or copying our language will not demonstrate alignment. Applicants must be able to evaluate unfamiliar situations, identify ethical concerns, conduct appropriate research, and make reasoned recommendations.



QUALITY CONTROL AND DEFINITION OF COMPLETION



Work must not be represented as complete until it has been reviewed and tested.



Depending on the responsibility, quality control may include:



* Checking every link and button

* Testing forms, payment processes,
 sequences, automations, and scheduling systems

* Reviewing work on desktop and mobile devices

* Confirming that the complete client or customer journey functions as intended

* Checking names, dates, prices, spelling, formatting, permissions, and access

* Verifying that claims, research, and recommendations are accurate

* Confirming BDS and broader ethical alignment

* Ensuring that the work meets the complete original brief

* Reporting anything that remains incomplete, uncertain, or untested



“Complete” means that the work has been finished, checked, and shown to function.



It does not mean that something has merely been drafted, uploaded, scheduled, or assumed to work.



Team members must communicate progress without waiting to be chased. If a deadline, deliverable, or result is at risk, we expect early communication together with a proposed solution.



PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY



Life happens, and genuine emergencies occur. Professional accountability means communicating promptly, taking responsibility, and helping protect the work when circumstances change.



Repeated lateness, last-minute notice about foreseeable conflicts, missed instructions, unexplained absences, unfinished work, or excuses in place of accountability will not be compatible with this team.



If you commit to a meeting, deadline, or agreed working period, we expect you to organize your other responsibilities accordingly.



Mistakes can be discussed and corrected. Dishonesty, repeated carelessness, misrepresentation of ability, and refusal to take responsibility cannot.



We are interested in what you can reliably contribute, not promises unsupported by evidence.



AI USE



We use AI in our work. Applicants may use AI tools to help organize, edit, or refine their applications and work.



Using AI is not a problem.



Using AI to misrepresent your experience, judgment, communication ability, knowledge, or technical competence is a problem.



We assume that some applicants will place this posting into an AI tool and generate polished answers. A polished application will not be treated as evidence that you can perform the work.



You must be able to explain and defend everything submitted under your name. You may be asked detailed follow-up questions about any answer, claim, recommendation, or work sample.



Shortlisted applicants will be tested through live discussion, unfamiliar scenarios, verification of previous work, and a paid practical assessment.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit a concise, personalized application that answers every question below.



1. Which specific area or areas listed in this posting are you applying for?



2. What are your three strongest professional skills?



3. Which responsibilities can you perform independently at a professional level?



4. Which responsibility listed here should we not hire you to perform, and why?



5. Describe one project for which you took meaningful ownership. What were you responsible for, what problem arose, and what result did you produce?



6. Describe a time you disagreed with a client or supervisor. How did you communicate your concern, and what happened?



7. Describe a professional mistake you made. How did you address it?



8. What does intersectional feminism mean to you, and how has it influenced a decision you have made?



9. What is your understanding of the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement?



10. Imagine that a potentially profitable sponsor, affiliate, platform, or business partner has a connection to a BDS target or a record of human-rights violations. Explain exactly what you would do before making a recommendation.



11. What would you do if you noticed that company content, a potential partner, or another team member’s recommendation conflicted with the stated values of Décalage Solutions?



12. How could your specific area of work contribute to both our mission and the financial success of the company?



13. What working hours can you reliably commit to? Include your time zone, availability, internet reliability, and current work commitments.



14. What is your expected hourly rate?



15. Provide links to relevant work samples, case studies, or a portfolio. Explain what part of each example you personally completed.



16. Include a link to a short video or voice introduction of no more than two minutes. Tell us why you are interested in Décalage Solutions and what you could contribute.



Begin your application with this sentence:



“I read the complete posting. I am applying in the area of __________.”



Generic, copied, mass-produced, or incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Statements that you are hardworking, passionate, loyal, dedicated, or willing to learn are not evidence of competence. Show us how you think, communicate, solve problems, and produce results.



SELECTION PROCESS



Our selection process is rigorous because we are looking for demonstrated ability, judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment.



Depending on the role, the process may include:



* Review of the complete written application

* Verification of previous work and results

* A short exploration meeting

* Detailed follow-up questions

* Live values and judgment scenarios

* A small, time-limited paid practical assessment

* Reference verification

* A clearly defined paid trial period

* Written expectations, deadlines, and performance measures



Before beginning a paid assessment, the applicant will receive the following information in writing:



* The task

* The expected deliverable

* The maximum authorized time

* The payment

* The deadline

* The evaluation criteria



Completing an assessment does not guarantee ongoing work.



Applicants may be evaluated on:



* Role-specific technical skill

* Accuracy and attention to detail

* Quality of judgment

* Emotional intelligence

* Ability to follow the complete brief

* Ability to identify missing information

* Clear and timely communication

* Appropriate use of AI and other tools

* Ability to explain decisions

* Application of feminist and ethical values

* Understanding and application of BDS

* Ability to receive and implement feedback

* Reliability and respect for deadlines

* Honest representation of competence

* Overall quality of completed work



Only agreed tasks and authorized time will be paid. Applicants must not exceed the stated time limit, expand the assignment, or perform additional work without written approval.



PAID TRIAL PERIOD AND CONTINUED WORK



Applicants who successfully complete the selection process may be offered a limited paid trial period for a specific role.



Each trial period will have clearly defined:



* Responsibilities

* Authorized working hours

* Deliverables

* Deadlines

* Communication expectations

* Performance standards

* Evaluation dates



Continued work depends on meeting the written standards established for the role.



Décalage Solutions may end a trial or working relationship if a team member:



* Cannot demonstrate the skills represented in their application

* Misrepresents experience, availability, competence, working time, or completed work

* Repeatedly misses or misunderstands clear instructions

* Produces work below the agreed standard

* Fails to meet agreed deadlines

* Does not communicate promptly about problems

* Requires substantially more supervision than the role permits

* Does not receive or implement feedback

* Is repeatedly unavailable during agreed working periods

* Records unauthorized hours or performs unauthorized work

* Does not meet the role’s written performance measures

* Disregards the company’s feminist, political, BDS, or ethical commitments



All authorized work completed up to the end of the arrangement will be paid. Ending the arrangement means that no additional work or hours will be assigned.



Please apply only if you are comfortable having your stated skills, professional judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment tested.



We are building a company with ambitious goals, substantive values, and high professional standards.



We want people who are proud to contribute to work that matters, who care whether the business succeeds, and who possess the professional discipline to help make that success possible.

title: Social Media Content Manager
description:
Facebook • Instagram • LinkedIn | Two Personal Brands | Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for an exceptional Social Media Content Manager to help manage the personal brands of two U.S.-based insurance and financial-services professionals: a mother and daughter who work together in business.



This is not a generic VA posting job.



We will provide you with the raw ingredients:



Photos

Videos

Personal stories

Business activities

Travel

Speaking engagements

Community involvement

Podcast content

Industry information

Ideas and thoughts

Context about what is happening in our lives and businesses



THE TWO PERSONAL BRANDS



You will be creating content for Kelly and Hailey, a mother-daughter team in the U.S. insurance and financial-services industry.



They work together but have different voices, personalities and audiences.



Your job is to learn both.



Kelly



Kelly is an experienced business owner, insurance professional, advocate, public speaker and community leader.



Her content includes:



Business and entrepreneurship

Insurance and financial education

Advocacy and public policy

Leadership

Community

Travel

Personal reflections

Family

Lifestyle

Speaking

Behind-the-scenes life

Podcast content

Her voice is thoughtful, confident, conversational and occasionally provocative.



Hailey



Hailey represents a different generation and perspective.



Her content should have its own voice and should NEVER simply be a rewritten version of Kelly's content.



Part of your job will be learning what makes each woman sound distinctly like herself.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Each day, you will receive or have access to photos, videos, ideas and context from Kelly and Hailey.



You will transform those materials into platform-appropriate content for:




Instagram

LinkedIn



Our initial content framework provides for up to:



3 content opportunities per platform, per person, per day.



That means you must be capable of managing a high-volume content pipeline across six social profiles.



However:

We value quality over filling a quota.



Not every content opportunity must become a feed post.



Depending on the content and platform, you should recommend whether something belongs as:



Feed post

Story

Reel

Carousel

Professional insight

Personal post

Short-form thought

Engagement post

Or should NOT be posted at all



We are looking for judgment, not just output.



PLATFORM DIFFERENTIATION IS REQUIRED



If Kelly gives you one photograph and tells you:



"I had coffee this morning with an insurance agent who reminded me how important mentorship is in our industry."



We do NOT want you to write one caption and copy it three times.



You should understand how to turn that ONE moment into:



LinkedIn



A professional thought about mentorship, leadership or developing the next generation of insurance professionals.






A warmer personal story about the conversation and relationship.



Instagram



A shorter, visually driven caption with an engaging hook.



Same person. Same photograph. Same underlying story. Three different pieces of content.



That ability is central to this job.



CONTENT SCHEDULE



Content will generally be distributed across three U.S. audience windows:



Morning: approximately 6:30–7:30 AM Pacific Time



Afternoon: approximately 11:00 AM–12:30 PM Pacific Time



Evening: approximately 4:30–6:00 PM Pacific Time



You do NOT need to be awake at those hours.



We expect you to use scheduling tools once direct publishing privileges have been granted.



Over time, you will also be expected to review analytics and recommend better posting times based on OUR actual audience behavior.



FIRST 30 DAYS



You will NOT initially receive direct access to our social media accounts.



During the training period:



We provide content → You create posts → We review → We approve or revise.



We will teach you our voices through feedback.



Your responsibility is to learn from that feedback so the number of revisions steadily decreases.



We are specifically looking for someone who can eventually reach the point where we read a post and say:



"Yes. That's exactly how I would have said it."



Once that trust has been established, we will provide appropriate access so you can schedule and publish approved content directly.



Eventually, the right person will independently manage much of the daily publishing calendar.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



At the beginning:



We correct you.



Then:



We occasionally correct you.



Eventually:



You know what we're going to say before we say it.



Our ideal Social Media Content Manager learns:



What Kelly will post

What Kelly will NOT post

What Hailey will post

What Hailey will NOT post

Their vocabulary

Their humor

Their opinions

Their professional boundaries

Their audiences

Their preferred content styles



We want someone interested in becoming part of our long-term media team.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



Create platform-specific social media copy

Organize provided photos and videos

Maintain a weekly content calendar

Recommend content formats

Create simple Canva graphics when appropriate

Schedule approved content

Maintain consistent personal-brand voices

Repurpose podcast and business content

Track published content

Monitor basic performance analytics

Identify which topics and formats perform best

Recommend improvements monthly

Maintain organized content archives

Avoid repetitive posts

Fact-check professional claims before submitting content

Flag anything you are unsure about rather than guessing



IMPORTANT: AI USE



You may use AI tools to assist your work.



However:



We do not want AI-generated personalities.



If every caption sounds polished, generic, inspirational and interchangeable, this will not work.



AI can help you work faster.



It cannot replace learning Kelly and Hailey's voices.



We will recognize generic AI copy immediately.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



Excellent written American English

Strong understanding of

Strong understanding of Instagram

Strong understanding of LinkedIn

Experience managing personal brands

Excellent attention to detail

Strong organizational skills

Canva proficiency

Experience with social scheduling tools

Ability to work independently

Reliable internet

Ability to meet weekly deadlines

Excellent judgment and discretion



Experience with insurance, financial services, professional services or executive personal brands is helpful but not required.



Writing ability and judgment matter more.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation: $250 USD per week



This is an independent contractor position.



The initial engagement will include a paid two-week trial period.



Compensation and responsibilities may increase as trust, independence and responsibility increase.



We are interested in a long-term relationship with the right person.



HOW TO APPLY:



 applications to:  



Begin your application with:



POUR IT OVER ICE



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



Then answer the following:



1.



Tell us about the personal brands you currently manage or have previously managed.



2.



Provide examples of
, Instagram and LinkedIn content YOU personally wrote.



3.



Tell us how you would make one story sound different on
, Instagram and LinkedIn.



4.



How do you learn a client's writing voice?



5.



What do you think is the biggest mistake business professionals make on social media?



6.



What social media scheduling and analytics tools have you used?



7.



How do you use AI in your content-creation process?



8.



How many hours per week would you expect this role to require?



9.



Are you currently working for other clients? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



10.



Why are you interested in a long-term role rather than project work?



FINALIST TEST



Selected finalists will receive the same:



Photograph

Short video

Background information

Personal context



You will be asked to create social content from that material.



The test will evaluate:



Writing quality

American English

Kelly vs. Hailey voice differentiation

 vs. Instagram vs. LinkedIn differentiation

Hooks

Judgment

Creativity

Accuracy

Attention to instructions



We are not looking for the person who creates the most content.



We're looking for the person we can eventually trust to speak in our voices.

title: Creator Sourcing & Outreach VA
description:
Real Mad Honey is a premium DTC brand selling wild Himalayan mad honey, sourced by hand at 3,500+ 

meters and third-party tested for purity. We've served 50,000+ customers and we're growing fast.



We're hiring a VA who will report directly to the Creator Partnerships Manager — owning creator sourcing, 

outreach, and keeping our whole partnerships operation organized and easy to navigate. This is a hands-on 

assisting role, not just task execution: you'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Finding Creators

• Look online for creators who make content we could work with.

• Check if each one is really a good fit for our brand — not just how many followers they have.

• Write down why each one is a good pick, so a decision can be made fast.

• Be the first point of contact, and inform the manager on rates for negotiation.



Organizing Our Files & Content

• Keep our files and folders neat, so anyone on the team can find what they need in seconds.

• When videos or photos come in from a creator, save, label, and keep track of them the right way — so 

nothing gets lost, and no one has to dig through a mess to find a clip later.

• Keep a simple, up-to-date list of every deal: who it's with, what stage it's at, when it's due, and whether 

it's paid.

• Make sure product gets shipped and creators get their tracking info.



Helping the Manager

• Tell the manager right away if a creator is doing great work — they might be worth a bigger deal.

• Tell the manager right away if something's going wrong. Don't wait and hope it fixes itself.

• Help build our creator community across our programs — seeding, ambassadors, and more.

• Help with other small tasks as they come up. This role grows as you do.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

• You know the kind of creators and personas that fit our brand.

• You've sourced your first few creators.

• You understand our budget and know how to lock in a deal — rate, contract, all of it.

• You know how our database works and how we keep it clean and organized.

• You understand the different creator programs we run, the tools we use to source, and how our whole 

system fits together.



First 60 Days

• You're finding and vetting creators without needing much guidance.

• Our files and content are organized well enough that someone else could jump in and understand 

everything.

• You're catching problems early and flagging them before they get bigger.

• You're starting to spot creators who could grow into bigger roles — ambassadors, repeat collaborators — 

and flagging them to the manager.



First 120 Days

• You're running the sourcing and organizing side of this role on your own.

• The manager trusts your picks and your organization without double-checking.

• You're already suggesting ways to make the process better.

• You're helping the manager grow our creator community across all our programs — seeding, 

ambassadors, Trybe, and beyond.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience with UGC sourcing or creator management, ideally in a DTC or e-commerce 

context.

• Comfortable finding and vetting talent across sourcing platforms.

• Experience supporting paid ads teams and understanding how UGC feeds into performance creative.

• Strong eye for creator quality — you can tell who fits the brand and who'll actually perform, before you 

ever send an outreach message.

• Excellent written English for outreach, negotiations, and creator briefs.

• Organized across multiple timelines, multiple creators, and multiple campaigns simultaneously.

• Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers and general workspace tools.



MUST HAVES

• Straight to the point communicator. No long, confusing instructions needed either direction.

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told.

• Integrity. We're remote and run on trust.

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing your own time without needing constant check-ins.

• This must be your only job. Full commitment, full presence.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Someone organized enough that a manager can hand off a messy pile of creator info and trust it comes back 

usable — clear, honest, and dependable.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us your resume (CV) and a short intro video telling us about yourself and your motivation — we want to 

see your energy and how you communicate, not just read about it.

If you're shortlisted, we'll send you the test assignment as the next step.



Start your application with the words “Honey Hive” so we know you actually read this whole posting.

We read everything. 



Real applications only — copy-paste responses will be ignored.

title: 🔥 HIRING: Performance Video Editor + AI Creative Specialist
description:
Help us build one of the leading kids health brands in Europe.



Remote · Full-Time · Strong Base + Uncapped Performance Bonuses



We’re not looking for someone who just wants another video editing job.



We’re looking for one person who wants to become world-class at performance creative - and wants their income to grow with their performance.



Wunderwell is a fast-growing German DTC brand building health products specifically for children.



But we’re not here to build another supplement company.



Our goal is to build the brand parents think of when it comes to supporting their children through the different stages and moments of growing up.



And creative is going to be one of the biggest reasons we get there.



That’s where you come in.



This is NOT a normal editing role.



We don't need someone who can make videos look pretty.



We need someone who understands why people buy.



You should care about:



Hooks.

Retention.

Pacing.

Emotional triggers.

Buyer psychology.

Direct response.

UGC.

Storytelling.

AI.

And ultimately: sales.



Your creatives won't disappear into some client folder.



They go live. They get real ad spend. We see exactly what happens.



If they lose, we learn.

If they win, we scale them.



And when your creatives win, you win financially too.



That feedback loop will allow you to become a much better marketer than someone who spends years editing videos without ever knowing whether they actually sold anything.



What you'll actually do



You'll work closely with one of our Founders and turn ideas, scripts and raw footage into ads that sell.



You do not need to speak German. We provide the German scripts, copy and strategic direction. Your job is to turn them into creatives that perform.



This is also not just a cut-and-caption job. A major part of this role is creating content yourself with AI - and then turning it into finished performance ads.



That includes:



- Cutting raw footage from our real UGC creators into high-converting Meta ads

- Finding and layering the right B-roll to strengthen every line of the script

- Creating strong hooks and maintaining attention throughout the video

- Understanding the marketing idea behind a brief instead of blindly executing it

- Studying our winning ads and understanding why they worked

- Iterating winners quickly with new hooks, openings, B-roll and structures

- Using AI to create footage we couldn't produce traditionally

- Creating AI B-roll and AI-generated scenes

- Creating realistic AI talking heads / avatars

- Creating AI animations and visualizations

- Using AI voiceovers and other AI-native creative formats

- Constantly testing new tools and workflows that make our creatives better or faster

- Looking at performance feedback and applying those learnings to your next edit



We already have creators producing real footage.



Your job is to turn those raw ingredients into something people stop scrolling for and eventually buy from.



We want someone OBSESSED with getting better.



You don't need to know every AI tool on day one.



But you do need to already be an excellent editor and you need to learn insanely fast.



You should be the type of person who sees a great ad and immediately wonders:



"Why does this work?"



Someone who saves winning ads.



Studies competitors.



Experiments with new AI tools before being asked.



Tries a different opening because you think it could perform better.



And actually shares ideas with the team.



We don't want someone waiting all day for the next task.



If you see an opportunity, say it.



If you think our brief could be better, tell us.



If you discover a new AI workflow that could change how we produce creatives, show us.



You start as an editor.



But editing does not have to be your ceiling.



The path



Performance Video Editor → Senior Editor → Creative Strategist → Creative Lead



How quickly you move through that path is largely up to you.



We want to teach you how we think about:



 Direct response marketing.

 Customer research.

 Hooks & angles.

 Copywriting.

 Creative strategy.

 Meta advertising.

 AI creative production.

 Performance analysis.



Our goal isn't to have you pushing buttons for us for the next three years.



Our goal is to make you dangerous.



Someone who can eventually look at an audience, understand what makes them buy, develop an angle, build the creative and analyze whether it worked.



And we reward performance.



There will be a competitive monthly base salary depending on your skill and experience.



But that's only the starting point.



On top of your base, you'll earn performance bonuses for winning creatives.



We want incentives aligned:



When Wunderwell grows because of your work, you should participate in that upside.



The better you become →

 the better your creatives perform →

 the more responsibility you earn →

 the more money you can make.



We're not interested in artificially capping an A-player.



If you become extremely valuable to Wunderwell, we want this to become an extremely valuable position for you.



We would rather overpay one great editor than underpay three average ones.



Who we're looking for



You probably fit if:



- You already have a strong video editing portfolio

- You've edited direct-response / DTC / e-commerce ads before

- You understand that an ad's job is to sell, not win a design award

- You're extremely comfortable with modern AI tools

- You can create convincing AI video, B-roll, talking heads and animations

- You're fast without becoming sloppy

- You're reliable and communicate quickly

- You take direct feedback without ego

- You're curious about marketing beyond editing

- You take ownership instead of waiting to be managed

- You genuinely want to become exceptional at what you do



Experience in supplements, health, wellness or parenting is a plus - but hunger and ability matter more.



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You want a comfortable 9–5 where you finish your assigned edits and collect your paycheck.

- You need someone to constantly tell you what to do.

- You disappear when things get busy.

- You take direct feedback personally.

- You need three days for an edit that should take a few hours.

- You care more about cinematic transitions than conversion.

- You aren't interested in AI.

- You aren't interested in understanding the numbers behind your creatives.

- Or you're looking to do the minimum required.



There are easier jobs.

This isn't one of them.



Why Wunderwell?



Because you're joining early enough that your work can actually matter.



We're ambitious.

We're building quickly.

We're constantly testing.



And we want people around us who see that as an opportunity rather than pressure.



You'll work closely with the people making the decisions.

You'll see what happens to the creatives you make.

You'll learn from real performance data.

You'll get access to the tools you need.

You'll be encouraged to experiment with AI.

You'll have room to take ownership far beyond editing.



And if you become one of the people who helps us turn Wunderwell into a major European brand, we want you to grow with it.



We're not looking for someone to fill an editing seat.



We're looking for someone who wants to earn their seat at the table.



How to apply



We're intentionally making the hiring process difficult.



Portfolio → Short Interview → Paid Test Edit → Final Call



We care much more about what you can actually do than what your CV says.



One important thing: Start your application with I'M ALL IN FOR WUNDERWELL so we know you actually read the entire post. 



Applications without it will NOT be considered.



When applying, send us:



1. Your 3 best performance ads



Not your prettiest videos.

Show us ads you believe actually sell.



2. Your best AI creative

title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel
description:
# YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel



We are looking for a talented **YouTube Documentary Video Editor** to join a growing faceless YouTube channel.



Our videos are story-driven documentaries focused on **Canada, cities, regional identity, history, culture, politics, economics, rivalries, and major events**.



Typical videos will be approximately **20–40 minutes long**.



This is not a simple “put stock footage over a voiceover” editing job.



We are looking for an editor who understands **storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, visual variety, and documentary-style editing**.



## WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE



For each video, you will generally receive:



* Final voiceover

* Completed script

* Organized visual assets

* Archival photographs and footage

* B-roll

* Maps, charts, screenshots and other supporting materials

* Source information where relevant

* Editing instructions for important sequences



You will **not normally be expected to research the entire video from scratch**.



However, a strong editor should be capable of finding additional appropriate visuals when something is missing or when a better visual would significantly improve the scene.



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will turn the supplied materials into a polished, engaging YouTube documentary.



This includes:



* Editing the complete video around the voiceover

* Selecting the strongest available visuals for each narration beat

* Creating strong visual pacing

* Using archival photographs and footage effectively

* Adding maps, headlines, screenshots, documents and graphics where appropriate

* Creating simple motion graphics and animations

* Adding tasteful zooms, pans and movement to still photographs

* Using text and on-screen information when it strengthens the story

* Adding appropriate music and sound design

* Mixing audio properly

* Creating smooth transitions between sections

* Maintaining visual continuity and a consistent documentary style

* Finding supplementary visuals when necessary

* Delivering a finished video ready for YouTube



## THE EDITING STYLE



The editing should feel like a **modern YouTube documentary**, not a corporate presentation and not an over-edited TikTok video.



We value:



**Storytelling over effects.**



Every visual should help explain the story, establish a location or period, provide evidence, create emotion, or maintain viewer attention.



We do NOT want random stock footage inserted simply because something needs to appear on screen.



We also do not want excessive transitions, constant sound effects, unnecessary animation, or distracting editing tricks.



Good judgment matters.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have experience editing long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, video essays, history content, geography content, or similar storytelling formats.



You should understand:



* YouTube audience retention

* Documentary pacing

* Visual storytelling

* B-roll selection

* Archival imagery

* Music and sound design

* Motion graphics

* Maps and basic data visualization

* How to keep a 20–40 minute video visually interesting without making it exhausting



You should also be comfortable receiving detailed feedback and making revisions.



## SOFTWARE



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform is acceptable.



After Effects or similar motion-graphics capability is an advantage.



## VERY IMPORTANT: COPYRIGHT



You must understand basic copyright and licensing requirements.



Do not download random images or footage from Google, YouTube, TikTok,
 or other websites and insert them into our videos without authorization.



Any additional assets you source must have appropriate licensing or usage rights, and the source must be documented.



## PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **small paid editing test of approximately 2–3 minutes**.



The same voiceover, script and asset package will be provided to shortlisted candidates so that editing quality can be compared fairly.



The test will evaluate:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Visual selection

* Music

* Sound design

* Graphics

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions

* Overall professional quality



## LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to become an ongoing position.



We are building a library of documentary videos and expect to publish consistently.



If your work is excellent, there will be regular projects available.



We value editors who become familiar with the channel's visual language and improve with each video.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to **2–3 of your best long-form YouTube edits**.

3. At least one example involving documentary, history, geography, politics, economics, video essay, or similar storytelling content if available.

4. Tell us exactly what parts of those videos you personally edited.

5. Tell us what editing software you use.

6. Tell us approximately how long you would need to edit a polished 25–30 minute documentary when the voiceover, script and most visual assets are supplied.

7. Tell us your expected rate for a 25–30 minute finished video.

8. Confirm whether you are willing to complete a paid 2–3 minute editing test.



**To show that you read the entire job post, begin your application with the words:**



**“DOCUMENTARY EDITOR”**



Applications that do not include these words may not be reviewed.



Please do not send 15–20 portfolio links. Send only your strongest and most relevant work.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term working relationship**, not simply complete one video.

Track outreach, responses and follow-ups

Google, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, company websites, Google Maps, Apollo or similar databases,
 verification tools, Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and AI research tools.

title: Content Creator / Social Media Expert
description:

This is a hands-on execution role for someone who can take content and marketing tasks from **idea → creation → scheduling → automation** without needing to be walked through every little step.



The ideal person is comfortable working across social media, short-form video, funnels, and marketing automation and enjoys working on multiple projects at once.



### What You'll Do

* Create engaging Instagram Reels and TikToks from provided content, footage, B-roll, graphics, and ideas

* Edit short-form videos using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar

* Create Instagram posts, carousels, Stories, and TikTok content

* Add captions, hooks, text overlays, trending audio, and appropriate hashtags

* Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats/platforms

**Content Scheduling**

, and TikTok

**Funnels & Marketing**

* Set up basic forms, thank-you pages, and
 sequences

**ManyChat & Automation**



* Build and manage basic ManyChat automations

* Set up comment-to-DM automations

* Connect social media calls-to-action to lead magnets, offers, and booking links

**General Marketing Support**



* Assist with launches, promotions, campaigns, and content projects

* Research trends, hooks, content ideas, and competitors

* Help keep multiple projects moving and organized

### You Should Have Experience With



**Required:**



* Instagram

* TikTok

* Canva

* CapCut or another short-form video editing platform

* Social media scheduling

* Google Drive/Google Workspace

* Strong written English

**Strongly preferred:**



* ManyChat

* GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Systeme.io, ClickFunnels, or similar

* Meta Business Suite

 marketing

* **Proactive** and doesn't wait to be told every next step

* Detail-oriented and catches mistakes before content goes live

* Creative and understands what makes short-form content engaging

* Organized enough to manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Comfortable learning new software

* Fast without sacrificing quality
