title: Amazon & D2C Listing Manager
description:
We are a European consumer goods company selling kitchen accessories and cleaning products on Amazon (DE, EU and US marketplaces) and through our own D2C webshop. Our team sits in Europe, works in English, and runs lean. You will work directly with our Brand Managers, not through three layers of management. 

We are looking for someone who wants to stay for years, grow into more responsibility, and actually own the catalog rather than just execute tickets. 



Catalog and listing management 

• Create, maintain and fix Amazon product listings across multiple marketplaces 

• Build and upload flat files (inventory, images, relationships, compliance attributes) 

• Set up variations, parentages, and new ASIN launches 

• Keep listing data consistent between Amazon and our D2C shop 

• Maintain listing content: titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ modules, backend keywords 

Problem solving with Amazon 

• Open, track and escalate Seller Support cases until they are actually resolved 

• Fix suppressed, stranded, blocked and hijacked listings 

• Handle category approvals, compliance documents, and brand registry topics 

Customer and review management 

• Answer and follow up on customer messages within Amazon SLA 

• Monitor and analyze product reviews, flag quality and content issues to the team 

• Manage review policy compliance 

Research and analysis 

• Product and competitor research (keywords, pricing, positioning) 

• Prepare simple, clean reports that a Brand Manager can act on 

• Flag risks, blockers and anything that could delay a task, early and in writing 

Team support 

• Assist Brand Managers with day-to-day Amazon tasks 

• Support onboarding and integration of newly acquired brands and products 

• Work with our Category Management, Channel Management, Marketing, Purchasing, Shop Management, BI and Product Management colleagues 

• Take on other operational tasks as agreed 



We are looking for service providers, not employees. You work as an independent contractor and invoice us monthly for your services. You are responsible for your own taxes, business registration and social contributions in the Philippines. We pay by [bank transfer / Wise / PayPal] within 15 days of receiving your invoice. 



What we offer 

• Long-term, stable full-time engagement 

• Direct access to decision makers, no bureaucracy 

• Real ownership of the catalog and room to grow into a Brand Manager role 



What you need to have 

Must have 

• 2+ years hands-on experience in Amazon Seller Central (not Vendor Central only) 

• Proven experience with flat files: you can build one from scratch and fix an upload error report without help 

• Experience opening and winning Seller Support cases 

• Strong written English, clear and direct 

• Reliable internet, own computer, and a quiet place to work 

• Attention to detail. Small data errors cost us real money 

• Able to work independently and report proactively without being chased 

• Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Sellerboard, or Asana 

• Excel or Google Sheets skills (filters, lookups, pivot tables)  

Nice to have 

• Experience with EU marketplaces (DE, FR, IT, ES, PL, SE, NL) 

• Experience with Shopify or another D2C shop platform 

• Experience with A+ Content and Brand Story 





How to apply 

Applications that do not follow these steps will not be reviewed. 

1. Start your message with the word FLATFILE in the subject line. 

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, describe the most complicated Amazon listing problem you personally solved. What was broken, what did you do, what was the result? 

3. Tell us which Amazon marketplaces you have worked on and how many ASINs you were responsible for. 

4. Answer this: a parent ASIN with 6 child variations shows only 2 children on the live listing. The other 4 are active in Seller Central. Name three things you would check first. 

5. Attach your CV and tell us your expected monthly rate in USD. 

We reply to every applicant who follows the steps above.

title: Advertising and Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Advertising Manager



Full-Time | Construction & Building Industry



Position Overview



An established and growing construction company specializing in highly targeted building projects is seeking a full-time Digital Marketing & Advertising Manager to take ownership of its marketing systems, advertising campaigns, lead-generation funnels, and project-management workflows.



This is not an entry-level or narrowly focused social media position. The selected candidate will inherit work created by a previous marketing professional and must be able to independently audit, evaluate, troubleshoot, correct, and improve the existing setup. After the initial review, this person will assume full responsibility for continuing and advancing the company’s marketing objectives.



Our goal is to consistently generate qualified leads for specific building types, geographic markets, and customer profiles—not simply increase clicks, followers, or general website traffic.



Required Platform Experience



Candidates must be highly proficient in:



* GoHighLevel, including CRM administration, pipelines, workflows, automations, forms, landing pages,
 and SMS campaigns, lead tracking, and reporting

*
 and Instagram advertising through Meta Ads Manager

* Google Ads, including Search, Display, YouTube, conversion tracking, remarketing, and geographic targeting

* YouTube channel management, advertising, content optimization, and lead-generation strategies

* Lovable for developing and improving landing pages, websites, tools, or marketing-related applications

* ClickUp for campaign planning, task management, documentation, accountability, and workflow organization



Working familiarity is not enough. The successful candidate must be capable of independently managing, correcting, and optimizing these platforms.



Primary Responsibilities



* Conduct a complete audit of the company’s existing marketing accounts, campaigns, funnels, websites, CRM structure, automations, tracking systems, and workflows

* Identify incomplete, ineffective, improperly configured, or poorly performing work inherited from the previous marketing professional

* Correct technical issues, tracking errors, broken automations, ineffective funnels, and inefficient campaign structures

* Develop and manage highly targeted advertising campaigns for specific construction and building projects

* Create campaigns based on project type, customer profile, geographic area, budget, and construction feasibility

* Manage
, Instagram, Google, and YouTube advertising from strategy through execution

* Build and optimize landing pages, lead forms, follow-up sequences, sales funnels, and conversion paths

* Manage GoHighLevel as the company’s primary CRM and marketing automation platform

* Ensure leads are properly captured, categorized, routed, tracked, and followed through the sales pipeline

* Develop retargeting campaigns for website visitors, previous leads, and prospective customers

* Monitor advertising budgets, cost per lead, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on advertising spend

* Coordinate marketing content across websites, social media,
, SMS, and YouTube

* Use ClickUp to organize campaigns, deadlines, approvals, deliverables, and recurring marketing responsibilities

* Provide clear reporting showing campaign performance, lead sources, cost per qualified lead, and recommended adjustments

* Explain complex marketing systems, workflows, automations, and technical processes in simple, easy-to-understand terms to non-technical team members.

* Continuously test advertising creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages, and offers

* Work closely with company leadership and sales personnel to ensure marketing efforts produce qualified, buildable opportunities

* Take full-time ownership of the company’s ongoing digital marketing and advertising objectives



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, technically capable, and comfortable taking over an existing marketing environment that may require substantial correction. This person should be able to determine what is working, what is not working, and what needs to be rebuilt—without requiring step-by-step supervision.



The successful candidate will understand that construction marketing is different from general consumer marketing. Leads must be evaluated based on location, project type, budget, timeline, property conditions, permitting considerations, and overall project viability.



Required Qualifications



* Demonstrated experience managing successful paid advertising campaigns

* Advanced proficiency with GoHighLevel

* Strong experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

* Experience managing Instagram and YouTube as marketing and advertising channels

* Experience building or modifying digital assets with Lovable

* Strong ClickUp project-management skills

* Ability to audit and repair work completed by another marketing professional

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking, analytics, attribution, and campaign reporting

* Experience building landing pages, funnels, CRM workflows, and automated follow-up sequences

* Excellent written communication and advertising-copy skills

* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities independently

* Strong attention to detail and a results-oriented mindset

* Availability to take on this position as a full-time responsibility



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience marketing construction, real estate, home improvement, steel buildings, barndominiums, accessory structures, commercial buildings, or other high-value projects

* Experience generating leads for products or services with long sales cycles

* Familiarity with local and regional geographic targeting

* Experience distinguishing qualified project opportunities from low-quality or nonviable leads

* Basic knowledge of SEO, website optimization, video marketing, and content strategy

* Experience working directly with business owners, estimators, sales teams, or construction professionals



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by:



* Quality and viability of generated leads

* Cost per qualified lead

* Conversion of leads into consultations, estimates, and contracts

* Accuracy of campaign and conversion tracking

* Performance of automated lead follow-up

* Improvement of existing marketing systems

* Consistent completion of campaigns and deliverables

* Ability to generate opportunities for the company’s targeted building projects



High lead volume alone will not be considered successful if the leads are poorly qualified or outside the company’s target markets.



Application Requirements



Please submit:



* A résumé outlining your relevant marketing experience

* Examples of campaigns you have personally managed

* A description of your experience with GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, Lovable, and ClickUp

title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:

Role Overview

You will be responsible for strategy, content, analytics, and community management across our social channels, with a clear focus on driving brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This is a hands‑on role suited for someone who enjoys building and testing content, not just “posting.”

Key Responsibilities

Research and continuously monitor current social media best practices, trends, algorithms, and platform features relevant to F&B and e‑commerce.

Conduct competitor and industry benchmarking to identify content formats, hooks, and offers that perform well in food and delivery niches.

Develop a clear social media strategy and content pillars aligned with our brand positioning, product offerings, and sales goals (awareness, leads, repeat orders, upsells).

Ideate and pitch content ideas (reels, stories, carousels, static posts, UGC concepts, live sessions, collabs, etc.) tailored to each platform and audience segment.

Create and manage a detailed social media content calendar, including key dates, launches, seasonal promotions, and recurring content series.

Brief us on what content to capture (behind‑the‑scenes, cooking processes, customer reactions, limited drops, educational content, etc.) and provide shot lists/storyboards where useful.

Where location makes sense, help with filming content (short‑form video, B‑roll, product shots, interviews) and directing on‑camera talent for best results.

Edit content (reels, shorts, stories) for specific objectives such as sales conversion, lead capture, or engagement, applying platform‑native formats, hooks, and CTAs.

Write and optimize captions, hooks, hashtags, CTAs, and on‑screen text that drive clicks, saves, shares, and orders.

Manage day‑to‑day posting, scheduling, and optimisation across all social channels (Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp/Telegram, and upcoming platforms) using relevant tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite, TikTok’s native tools).

Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and mentions to build community, handle simple customer queries, and encourage repeat purchases.

Track and analyse key metrics (reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, click‑through, conversion, sales from campaigns) and produce regular performance reports with clear recommendations.

Run or support paid social campaigns (e.g. Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) where relevant, including basic audience targeting, budgeting, and creative optimisation.

Suggest experiments (A/B testing hooks, thumbnails, formats, posting times, offers) and systematically document learnings to improve ROI over time.

Stay current on F&B and food‑content trends (e.g. plating styles, ASMR/cinematic food shots, creator collabs, delivery promotions) and propose content/partnership ideas based on them.

Coordinate with us on promotions, drops, new products, and customer feedback to ensure social media messaging is accurate and aligned with operations.

Required Skills & Experience

Proven experience (ideally 2–5 years) in social media marketing, content creation, or digital marketing, with measurable results (growth, engagement, sales, ROAS).

Strong proficiency with major platforms (Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube) and comfort exploring emerging platforms relevant to our audience.

Demonstrated ability to build and execute social media strategies and content calendars for small businesses or brands.

Solid understanding of social media analytics and insights, and ability to translate data into clear actions and experiments.

Competence in short‑form video and basic design/editing tools (e.g. Canva, CapCut, Adobe tools or similar), especially for reels/shorts.

Strong copywriting skills for hooks, captions, and storytelling, with an eye for brand voice and persuasive CTAs.

Comfortable working directly with founders/owners and giving strategic and creative recommendations while respecting brand constraints.

Ability to work independently, manage timelines, and communicate clearly with us on performance, plans, and next steps.

Nice‑to‑Have

Prior experience in F&B, hospitality, or e‑commerce marketing, particularly in Singapore or similar markets.

How to Apply

Please share:

Your CV or LinkedIn profile

Portfolio or examples of social media work (preferably including reels/shorts and campaigns with results)

A short note on why you’re interested in working with a smoked meat brand and what you would focus on in the first 3 months

title: Social Media Content Creator & UGC Coordinator (Full-Time, Long-Term)

What We Offer

How to Apply

title: Ai Graphic Designer
description:
# FREELANCE AI PRODUCT GRAPHIC DESIGNER / PHOTOSHOP RETOUCHER



**Employment Type:** Freelance / Project-Based Contractor

**Work Setup:** Remote – Philippines

**Compensation:** **$2 USD per completed image**



We are looking for skilled **AI Product Graphic Designers / Photoshop Retouchers** to join our growing creative team.



This is a **freelance, project-based contractor role and is not full-time employment**. Projects are assigned as client work becomes available, so weekly volume may vary and there is no guaranteed minimum number of projects, images, hours, or income.



We are specifically looking for designers who can create **realistic, high-quality e-commerce product images using Photoshop and AI tools while keeping every important product detail completely accurate**.



Making an image visually attractive is not enough.



You must be able to recognize when AI has changed a product's logo, packaging, proportions, colors, materials, text, or other important features—and know how to manually correct those problems in Photoshop.



## What You'll Be Creating



Projects may include:



* E-commerce product advertisements

* AI-assisted product photoshoots

* Lifestyle product compositions

* Product photo manipulation

* Product retouching

* Photorealistic product composites

* AI-generated backgrounds

* AI-generated environments

* AI-generated models combined with real product assets

* Meta advertising graphics

* TikTok advertising graphics

* Amazon product creatives

* Shopify creatives

* Social-media product images

* Product-focused direct-response advertisements

* Creative variations for testing



Depending on the assignment, you may receive:



* Original product packshots

* Brand guidelines

* Product information

* Reference images

* Creative briefs

* Existing product assets



Your job is to transform those materials into polished, realistic, ready-to-publish creative while maintaining **complete product accuracy**.



## Compensation



**$2 USD per completed image.**



Graphic-design projects will commonly be assigned in batches.



Typical examples include:



* **7-image set = $14 USD**

* **15-image set = $30 USD**

* **3-image lifestyle pack = $6 USD**

* **5-image lifestyle pack = $10 USD**

* **10-image lifestyle pack = $20 USD**



Lifestyle packs will typically contain approximately **3–10 images** and may be used for social-media or e-commerce campaigns.



The final number of images will vary depending on the project.



The standard compensation remains:



**$2 USD per completed image.**



## Key Responsibilities



You will be expected to:



* Create realistic e-commerce product images using **Adobe Photoshop and approved AI-generation tools**.

* Generate backgrounds, environments, lifestyle scenes, or models using AI when appropriate.

* Combine AI-generated imagery with original product assets.

* Manually composite original product assets into generated scenes when required.



You must maintain complete accuracy of:



* Logos

* Packaging text

* Product colors

* Product proportions

* Scale

* Materials

* Textures

* Product features

* Labels

* Product claims



You will also be expected to:



* Match perspective realistically.

* Create accurate lighting and shadows.

* Build realistic reflections.

* Match depth, scale, and product placement.

* Recognize AI-generated errors.

* Correct AI errors manually rather than relying entirely on regeneration.

* Perform professional masking.

* Perform high-quality retouching.

* Create realistic compositing.

* Perform color correction.

* Use non-destructive Photoshop workflows whenever appropriate.

* Follow creative briefs and brand guidelines accurately.

* Follow reference images, file-naming conventions, and delivery specifications.

* Maintain organized editable working files.

* Review your own work carefully before submitting it.

* Apply feedback accurately.

* Avoid repeating mistakes that have already been corrected.

* Communicate missing assets, unclear instructions, technical problems, or possible delays **before the deadline**.

* Identify problems early and propose practical solutions.



## Source-File Organization



Your Photoshop files should be professionally organized with properly named:



* Layers

* Layer groups

* Masks

* Smart objects

* Linked assets



Editable source files must be delivered when requested.



## What We're Looking For



Ideally, you have:



* At least **3 years of professional experience** in graphic design, product retouching, photo manipulation, or e-commerce creative production.



Exceptional portfolios may be considered in place of the experience requirement.



You should have advanced Adobe Photoshop skills, including:



* Masking

* Compositing

* Color correction

* Lighting

* Shadows

* Reflections

* Perspective matching

* Smart objects

* Non-destructive editing



You should also have:



* Proven experience creating realistic product photo manipulations.

* Experience creating lifestyle product compositions.

* Experience producing photorealistic AI-assisted product photoshoots.

* Experience creating advertising images.

* Experience combining AI-generated environments or models with original product assets.

* Strong understanding of scale and proportion.

* Strong understanding of perspective.

* Strong understanding of lighting and materials.

* Exceptional attention to product accuracy.

* Ability to recognize AI errors and manually correct them in Photoshop.

* Ability to follow detailed creative briefs.

* Ability to work independently.

* Strong file-organization habits.

* Reliable communication.

* Ability to consistently meet agreed deadlines.

* Ability to receive direct feedback and complete revisions quickly.

* Strong problem-solving and ownership.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Established e-commerce brands

* Direct-to-consumer brands

* Meta advertising creatives

* TikTok advertising creatives

* Amazon product graphics

* Shopify product creatives

* AI image generation

* Inpainting

* Outpainting

* AI upscaling

* Reference-controlled generation

* Reviewing another designer's work

* Creating creative workflows or SOPs

* Basic AI image-to-video workflows



Approved AI subscriptions and generation credits may be provided for company projects when required.



# HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your application to:







Use a clear subject line such as:



**Graphic Designer Application – Your Name**



## 1. Send Your Graphic Design Portfolio



Please send **5 of your strongest and most relevant product-design samples**.



We are especially interested in:



* E-commerce product advertisements

* Product retouching

* Photo manipulation

* Lifestyle product compositions

* AI-assisted product photography

* Photorealistic AI advertising images



### You must also include:



**At least 2 before-and-after Photoshop examples**



Show:



* Original image

* Final retouched or manipulated result



**At least 2 AI-assisted product-image examples**



Show:



* Original product reference

* Final image

* Which parts were AI-generated

* Which parts were manually edited in Photoshop



**Applications without relevant product examples may not be reviewed.**



## 2. Confirm the Compensation



Please confirm in your
 that you understand and accept our compensation structure:



**$2 USD per completed image.**



Projects are typically assigned in multi-image batches.



If you are not comfortable with this rate, please do not apply.



## 3. Answer These Screening Questions



Please **copy and answer all questions below** in your application
.



### Graphic Designer Screening Questions



**1. How many years have you professionally worked in graphic design, Photoshop retouching, product manipulation, or e-commerce creative production?**



**2. How would you rate your Photoshop ability from 1–10?**



Briefly tell us which Photoshop tasks you perform regularly.



Examples:



* Masking

* Compositing

* Retouching

* Color correction

* Perspective matching

* Lighting

* Shadows

* Reflections

* Smart objects



**3. Which AI image-generation tools do you currently use confidently?**



Please list only tools you have actual hands-on experience using.



Also mention whether you have experience with:



* Inpainting

* Outpainting

* Reference-image generation

* AI upscaling

* Product-consistency workflows



**4. Have you professionally created product advertisements or e-commerce creatives?**



If yes, briefly describe the types of products, brands, or platforms you have worked with.



**5. From the portfolio samples you submitted, which ONE image best demonstrates your product-compositing ability, and why?**



Briefly explain:



* What the original assets were

* What you personally created

* What was AI-generated

* What was manually edited

* What the biggest technical challenge was



**6. When combining a real product packshot with an AI-generated environment, what steps do you take to make the final result look realistic?**



Keep your answer short and focus on the most important steps.



**7. An AI-generated image looks excellent, but you notice that the product logo is slightly warped, the product is approximately 10% wider than the original, and its material has changed from matte to glossy. What would you do?**



Answer in 2–4 sentences.



**8. Would you ever submit an AI-generated product image that looks attractive if one important product detail is inaccurate? Why or why not?**



**9. Before submitting a finished product image, what are the five most important things you personally check?**



**10. How do you organize your Photoshop source files?**



Briefly describe your approach to:



* Layers

* Groups

* Masks

* Smart objects

* File naming



**11. If you realize you may miss a deadline because an important asset is missing or an AI-generation workflow is failing, when and how would you communicate this to the team?**



**12. What is your typical turnaround time for a standard e-commerce product image with simple-to-moderate Photoshop compositing?**



**13. What is your current weekly availability?**



Please list the days you are normally available to receive freelance projects.



**14. Please confirm: Are you comfortable accepting $2 USD per completed image?**



Answer **YES or NO**.



# Hiring Process



Candidates who pass the initial application screening may move through the following steps:



1. **Portfolio Review**

2. **10-Minute Quality-Control Assessment**

3. **Portfolio / Photoshop Interview**

4. **Standardized Paid Design Test**



## Portfolio Review



We may compare your finished images directly against the original product references.



We will specifically check whether you preserved:



* Logo

* Packaging text

* Product color

* Proportions

* Materials

* Product features



We may also ask you to explain exactly what you created manually versus what was generated with AI.



## Quality-Control Assessment



Shortlisted applicants may receive a product image containing intentional errors.



Examples may include:



* Warped logo

* Incorrect product color

* Incorrect shadow

* Changed product material

* Distorted proportions



You will be asked to identify the problems and explain how you would correct them.



## Portfolio / Photoshop Interview



You may be asked to open a Photoshop project that you personally created and explain:



* What was AI-generated

* What was manually edited

* How the product was composited

* What problems you encountered

* How you protected logos and packaging

* How you handled feedback

* What you would improve if you created the image again



You may also be asked to show your Photoshop layers and working-file organization.



## Standardized Paid Test



Final candidates may be asked to complete a **paid design test**.



For example, you may receive one clean product packshot and be asked to:



* Create one realistic **4:5 lifestyle product image**

* Generate the environment using an approved AI tool

* Composite the original product manually in Photoshop

* Preserve the exact product logo

* Preserve all product text

* Preserve product color

* Preserve product proportions

* Preserve materials

* Preserve essential product features

* Deliver the final image

* Deliver an organized layered PSD

* Briefly explain your process



The test may use a fixed **2–3 hour working window**.



Applicants completing the same test will receive the same core product, brief, reference, deadline, requirements, and compensation.



We do **not** use unpaid client work as an applicant test.



# How We Evaluate Designers



Candidates are primarily evaluated on:



* **Product Accuracy – 30%**

* **Photoshop & Realism – 20%**

* **Brief Compliance – 15%**

* **Composition & Brand Fit – 10%**

* **Source-File Organization – 10%**

* **Speed & Reliability – 10%**

* **Communication & Ownership – 5%**



Critical product inaccuracies—including incorrect logos, packaging text, essential product features, materials, or proportions—may disqualify a candidate regardless of how attractive the final image looks.



A strong portfolio alone is not enough.



We are not simply looking for the cheapest applicant or the most confident designer.



We want someone who repeatedly demonstrates:



* Product accuracy

* Realism

* Strong Photoshop ability

* Attention to detail

* Reliability

* Coachability

* Clear communication

* Problem-solving

* Ownership of their work



A great designer should not simply generate an attractive image.



They should recognize when something is wrong, manually correct it, protect the integrity of the product, communicate risks early, and consistently deliver organized professional work.

title: GoHighLevel Operations Specialist (Client Sub Account Builds + AI Agents)
description:
What we do



We build AI phone agents and follow up systems for small service businesses in the US. Personal injury law firms, med spas, dental offices, HVAC and roofing companies, real estate teams. The client pays us, we build the whole back end in GoHighLevel, and their phone gets answered and their leads get followed up around the clock.



The systems work. The bottleneck is me. Every sub account build is currently sitting on my plate, and it is slowing down how many clients we can take on.



That is the job. You own the build.



What you will actually do



You take a new client from signed to live in about two weeks, following our internal setup checklist. Every step of that checklist is a thing you should already know how to do:



Provision the LC Phone number and submit A2P 10DLC registration under the client's legal name and EIN, then push it through to approval

Set up
 sending on a subdomain and get SPF, DKIM and DMARC all verified and landing in the Gmail inbox

Build calendars with the right duration, buffers, availability and timezone, and test the booking widget end to end

Build the pipeline and stages to match how the client actually sells

Create custom fields and custom values before you build anything that references them

Build the automations: missed call text back, instant response inside 60 seconds, and a Day 1, Day 2, Day 4, Day 7 follow up mixing SMS and
 that stops the second someone replies or books

Build and configure the AI agents, conversational and voice, including the knowledge base and the handoff trigger to a human

Test every entry point with a real contact before anything is called live

Set up the client user, the dashboard widgets, and the support ticket form



When you message me about this role, use the subject line First Ring Ops followed by the one automation you would turn on before any other for a brand new client. Two words for the subject, then your answer.



Over time this role grows into owning our internal systems too. Onboarding automations, invoicing workflows, and the templates we reuse across every new client.



Who I am looking for

Real GoHighLevel experience. Not "I watched tutorials." You have built sub accounts for actual paying clients.

HighLevel certified is a strong plus. If you are not certified, show me the work instead and you are still in the running.

Two or more years in marketing automation, CRM builds, or agency operations. If you have less time but your GHL and AI skills are sharp, apply anyway and let the work speak.

You have built or configured an AI agent before. Conversational AI, Voice AI, a chatbot, an n8n or Make workflow, something. This is the highest priority skill on this list next to GHL itself.

You know what a silent fail looks like. Workflows that reference a field that does not exist, overlapping enrollments, two campaigns firing on the same contact.

Written English good enough to write client facing SMS and
 copy that does not sound like a robot wrote it.

You test your own work before you tell me it is done.



Nice to have: DNS and domain experience, Twilio, funnel and website builds, Zapier or Make, basic Canva.



The sample task



Do not send me a resume with nothing attached. I want to see how you think.



The scenario: A roofing company in Marietta, Georgia. Two crews, one owner, one office manager. They spend about $3,
 a month on
 lead ads and miss most of the calls that come in because everybody is on a roof. They have never used a CRM.



Send me these four things:



A screen recording, six minutes or less, walking me through a missed call text back workflow inside a GHL account you have access to. Show me the trigger, the actions, and the stop condition. Talk out loud about why you built it that way. Loom or Google Drive link is fine.

A list of the custom fields you would create for this client before you build a single workflow, and one line on why each one matters.

The first SMS that goes out when a new lead comes in from the ad. Write it the way you would actually send it, including opt out language.

One short paragraph: the client's A2P campaign gets rejected. What are the first three things you check?



If you already have a portfolio of client sub accounts you have built, send that too. Screenshots of the workflow builder, calendars, pipelines, and any AI agent configuration. Real work beats a practice task every time.



This should take you under an hour. If it takes longer than that, this role probably is not the right fit, and that is fine.



How you will be judged



Not on how pretty it looks. On whether the workflow has a stop condition, whether the fields exist before the automations that use them, whether the SMS sounds like a human, and whether you followed the instructions in this post exactly as written.



How to apply



Reply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



The subject line described above

Your GHL experience: how many sub accounts, what industries, how long

Your HighLevel certification status

The four sample task items

Your portfolio link if you have one

Your rate and your available hours in US Eastern time

At the very bottom, tell me how long the sample task took you



I read every application myself. If your work is solid you will hear from me inside 48 hours and we will do a short call where you walk me through one of your builds live.

title: Performance Content Editor — Direct Response
description:
*Remote | Kalrah & Nooralife | Trial → Long-Term Role*



We’re looking for a *Performance Content Editor* to work across *Kalrah & Nooralife*, creating direct-response video ads primarily for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make videos that “look nice.”



We want an editor who understands — or is hungry to learn — *what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching and take action.*



You’ll work with our existing content bank, product footage, UGC-style footage and AI-generated content to produce performance-focused creatives that we can continuously test and scale.



We’re looking for someone we can train, develop and work with long term.



## PART 1 — THE ROLE



Your main responsibility will be producing approximately *30 performance creatives per month*.



### 1A. Meta Ad Editing



Create direct-response video ads for
 and Instagram using:



* Existing footage from our content bank

* Product footage

* UGC-style content

* Voiceovers

* Text overlays

* Testimonials and social proof

* Different hooks, angles and CTAs

* Winning creative references



Your job is not simply to assemble clips.



Every hook, cut, piece of text, visual and CTA should have a reason for being there.



### 1B. Performance Creative



You will learn to think about editing through a performance lens.



That means understanding concepts such as:



* Hooks

* Scroll stopping

* Retention

* Pacing

* Direct-response structure

* Creative angles

* Calls to action

* Winning vs losing creatives

* ROAS and advertising performance



We will share references, feedback and performance data so you can continuously improve your edits.



### 1C. AI Content Creation



You’ll also use AI tools to help us create new content and extend what we can produce from our existing assets.



This could include:



* AI-generated scenes

* AI voiceovers

* AI-assisted UGC

* Product visualisation

* Creative variations

* Extending or modifying existing content



You do not need to already be an expert in every AI tool.



Being comfortable learning new technology quickly is more important.



### 1D. Creative Iteration



Winning ads rarely come from making one video and moving on.



You may take an existing creative and create multiple variations by changing:



* The first 3 seconds

* Hook

* Opening visual

* Voiceover

* Text

* Pacing

* CTA

* Creative angle



You should be comfortable testing, learning and iterating.



---



# PART 2 — WHAT WE OFFER



### Long-Term Opportunity



This starts as a *trial role*, with the intention of developing the right person into a long-term member of our creative team.



We are not looking for someone who disappears after one project.



### Base Pay



*USD $250 for 30 videos per month during the initial arrangement.*



The scope and compensation can grow as your responsibilities, skills and performance grow.



### Performance Upside



We believe editors should benefit when their work performs.



There will be opportunities for *performance bonuses / commission for winning ads*, with performance judged using metrics such as:



* ROAS

* Creative performance

* Ads that become scalable winners



The better you become at producing profitable creatives, the greater your earning potential can become.



### Training & Growth



You’ll receive:



* Creative references

* Direct feedback

* Advertising performance insights

* Guidance on direct-response editing

* Exposure to AI creative tools

* Opportunities to take greater creative ownership over time



We want someone who wants to become a *seriously good performance creative editor*, not just process editing tasks.



---



# PART 3 — WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



### Detail-Oriented



You notice the small things.



Bad subtitles, awkward cuts, inconsistent fonts, poor timing, incorrect product details and sloppy exports should bother you.



### Reliable



If you say something will be delivered, we expect it to be delivered.



No disappearing. No constantly needing to be chased.



### Fast



Performance marketing moves quickly.



You should be able to produce and revise content efficiently without sacrificing quality.



### Takes Feedback Well



We will give direct creative feedback.



You should be able to receive feedback, understand the reasoning behind it and apply it to future work — rather than needing the same correction repeatedly.



### Performance-Minded



You understand that:



*A beautiful ad that doesn't sell is not a winning ad.*



We care about aesthetics, but the ultimate goal is performance.



### Strong Reference Matching



If we send you a successful ad or reference, you should be able to break it down:



* Why does the hook work?

* How is it paced?

* What creates curiosity?

* What footage is being shown?

* When does the product appear?

* How is the offer introduced?

* Why does someone keep watching?



Then use those principles to create something for our brands.



### Tech Comfortable



*CapCut proficiency is required.*



Experience with any of the following is a bonus:



* Canva

* ElevenLabs

* Veo

* Google Flow

* Higgsfield

* Other AI video/image generation tools



You do not need to know everything.



We care more about whether you can learn quickly and execute properly.



---



# PART 4 — HOW WE WORK



This is a *fully remote role*.



Communication will mainly happen through:



*WhatsApp /
*



We expect clear and responsive communication.



You do not need to send unnecessary messages all day, but you should:



* Acknowledge instructions

* Ask questions when something genuinely isn't clear

* Give updates when required

* Tell us early if there is an issue

* Never disappear during an active project



Expected output is approximately:



*30 completed performance videos per month.*



---



# PART 5 — HOW TO APPLY



We care much more about your *work, thinking and attitude* than a generic application.



To show us that you actually read this job description, start your application with:



*“MANGO”*



Then include:



### 1. Your Details



* Name

* Location

* 
 or

*



### 2. Portfolio



Send us your strongest examples of:



* Meta/Facebook ads

* E-commerce videos

* UGC-style ads

* Direct-response editing

* Short-form content

* AI-generated content



You do not need experience in every category.



Show us your *best work*, not every video you have ever made.



### 3. Tell Us About Yourself



In a few sentences, tell us:



*Why do you think you would be good at creating ads that actually make people buy?*



Do not send us a corporate essay.



We want to understand how you think and what kind of person we would be working with.



### 4. One More Detail



Somewhere naturally inside your application, include the word:



*“LYCHEE”*



Don't make it a heading.



We'll know why it's there.



---



## Important



We are *not asking for an unpaid test edit* as part of the initial application.



If your portfolio and application stand out, we will contact you directly for the next stage.



Applications that clearly ignore the instructions above may not be considered.

title: Graphic Designer for Beauty E-commerce & Meta Ads
description:
The Beauty Cartel Au is looking for a talented and creatively driven Graphic Designer to help bring our campaigns, products and online presence to life.



We are an Australian beauty supply and education brand specialising in professional lash, nail and beauty products. Our brand is bold, feminine, fun and instantly recognisable, and we are looking for someone who can build upon this identity while creating designs that are both visually impressive and commercially effective.



This role will include designing:



• Meta advertising creatives for
 and Instagram

• Website banners and promotional graphics

• Product launch campaigns

• Social media graphics and carousels

•
 campaign graphics

• Product packaging, labels and product design concepts

• Sale and seasonal campaign assets

• Graphics resized across multiple digital platforms



We are looking for someone who:



• Is highly skilled in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Affinity, Canva or similar professional design software

• Has strong typography, layout, colour and visual hierarchy skills

• Can professionally edit, retouch and manipulate product photography

• Understands how to create Meta ad creatives that capture attention and encourage conversions

• Can follow established brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas

• Has experience designing for e-commerce, beauty, fashion or lifestyle brands

• Can create website banners that work across both desktop and mobile

• Has experience with product packaging, labels or product mockups

• Is organised, reliable and able to meet agreed deadlines

• Can take feedback and confidently revise their work

• Pays close attention to spelling, sizing, spacing and small design details



Experience within the beauty industry is highly valued, but an exceptional portfolio and strong understanding of our target audience are more important.



HOW TO APPLY



Please review our brand before applying:



Website: 





Your application must include:



A link to your portfolio, including examples of advertising creatives, website banners, social media campaigns and product or packaging design.

A short introduction explaining your design experience, the programs you use and why you believe you would be a strong fit for The Beauty Cartel Au.

Your hourly rate, usual availability and current working timezone.

After reviewing our Instagram and website, briefly explain what you believe makes The Beauty Cartel Au visually distinctive and what opportunities you see for strengthening our campaign graphics.

Submit one original Meta advertisement concept showing how you would promote one of our existing products. You may choose any product currently available on our website.



Your concept should include:



• One static Meta feed advertisement in a 4:5 format

• A strong campaign headline or hook

• Clear product positioning

• A call to action

• A short explanation of your creative direction and why you believe it would appeal to our target customer



Watermarked or low-resolution concepts are accepted. This initial concept is for recruitment assessment only and will not be published or used commercially without payment and permission.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial project. The trial will help us assess your ability to interpret a brief, meet deadlines, provide editable source files and respond to feedback.



Please begin your application with the words “TBC DESIGNER” so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted long-term creative partner as The Beauty Cartel Au expands its product range, advertising campaigns and international presence.
